rationale: Every run is feasible with wide margins (hold >= 0.038 ns, 0 DRC, <= 324 slew/cap pins), so only T_eff matters. The AREA 3 + timing-driven placement + post-GRT timing/design repair + cap213 recipe plateaus near 8.8 ns: utilisation 30-48 shifts T_eff under 0.15 ns (42 best), while stronger repair pressure (target 0.497->0.49->0.47, margins rising) gave steady small gains (8.917->8.846->8.785). Setting 1 keeps the util-42 winner and adds pressure: target 0.46, margins 0.40/0.35 (high margins should also hold up when re-checked at T_eff). Setting 2 is identical but uses DELAY 4 synthesis, a clean A/B: its only run (11.97) lacked timing-driven placement and post-GRT design repair, so this faster-logic script is untested with our winning backend.
